record_scope_reconstruction: ElPaís enumerates twelve migration posts: seven Venezuela (Paraguachón, SimónBolívar, Santander, PuertoSantander, JoséAntonioPáez, river PuertoCarreño and PuertoInírida), river Leticia/Brazil, river PuertoLeguízamo/Peru, and Ecuador Rumichaca, Chiles–Tufiño, SanMiguel. Three existing named road-bridge references are supportable; entire country borders would overstate this list.
